title: CreRaces Mod Bridge
description: A Datapack for CreRaces Cross-Mod Compatibility
body:
This Datapack only works on CreRaces versions b1.7 and above!

Welcome to the CreRaces Cross-Mod Compatibility Bridge!

This Datapack adds CreRaces support to different mods through the usage of different tags.

Join the Discord Server! https://discord.gg/QagkwvSWtC

<details>
<summary>Supported Mods</summary>

**[Grimoire of Gaia](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/grimoire-of-gaia 'Mod Page')**

</details>
